reviewers.summary: The updated test checks a 429 response, but only from a test-defined route that implements the expected behavior. The previously raised AC-030 endpoint coverage gap remains.

findingList.message: The AC-030 test still does not verify the real reset endpoint's HTTP denial response. Its test-only route hardcodes the limiter call and 429 body, so a broken production endpoint would go undetected.

evidence.codePathTraced: ResetOutcomeFactory adds a test-only /__reset-test/{outcome} handler that calls the limiter and constructs its own 429 response. AC030_ResetAttemptsCountEveryAuthenticatedOutcome sends requests to that handler at line 194.
